posts.title: The Roleplayers Guild ||GR8:RP||
posts.html:
Seeing as all the minges are crippling the servers reputation i say we make a guild. The guild that those who have been here for 4 months + or are shit hot rpers should be welcomed into. These people would be people who the server could trust and could trade a sniper for 10k without getting anal. People who are not admins but know what the hell to do and offer advice.

Of course all admins who are not completely retarted would be in the guild and those who are chosen by the guild would have to be trained in the ways of "Dont shoot him in the bollocks tell him off".

I know that would be a great politics speach but who cares if it goes well.

I support this. I say all the people (not admins or mods etc) in this group get a special scoreboard simple, so you'll know who you can try a roleplay with. I just hope someone listens to this.
